---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ['enhancement', 'feature-request']
---

## Description
Clear description of the feature you're requesting.

## Motivation
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
How should this feature work? Describe the expected behavior.

## Alternatives Considered
Other approaches or workarounds you've considered.

## Examples
If applicable, provide examples or mockups of how this feature would work.

## Technical Details
Any technical notes or implementation suggestions.

## Checklist
- [ ] I checked existing issues and discussions
- [ ] This feature aligns with project goals
- [ ] I can help implement this (optional)
